task: L1 — model -> every reference point, with that point's own art parameters

stockTables.notUsed: Units\AbilityData.slk — MEASURED: it contains no Casterart / Targetart / Missileart / EffectSound column at all

counting.referencePoint: one place in the map that names one model file
counting.levelDedup: a w3a art cell repeated across ability levels with the SAME value is ONE reference (`levels` lists the levels); a different value per level is a different reference
counting.clearedCells: an art cell present but EMPTY is a deliberate erase: counted as a clear, and it BLOCKS stock inheritance for that channel
counting.extensionOptional: a model path need not end in .mdl/.mdx
counting.lightningExcluded: Lightning.slk ids carry no model and are not counted
